author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 2.4.0: Removed the lastUpdate attribute, which fired an event on every update (~2,880/day at the default 30s throttle) because its timestamp value always differed. Replaced with a healthStatus attribute (online/offline) driven by a scheduled staleness check, so it only fires on an actual health transition. Staleness threshold is configurable, default 1 hour. Note: anything bound to lastUpdate (dashboard tiles, rules) must be updated.
